package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for indentedjson_in_hot_path: IndentedJSON(...) used on a request path instead of compact JSON rendering.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func scenario319Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	payload := map[string]any{
		"status":  "ok",
		"message": "request processed successfully",
		"data":    []string{"alpha", "beta", "gamma"},
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(w)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.Encode(payload)
}
